query:
DELETE FROM microsoft_oauth_grant_versions g WHERE g.grant_id = $1 AND g.generation = $2 AND g.fusionauth_user_id = $3
            AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_links l WHERE l.grant_id = g.grant_id AND l.grant_generation = g.generation AND l.is_sync_active)
            AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_mailbox_custodians c WHERE c.grant_id=g.grant_id AND c.grant_generation=g.generation)
